title: A nonsense mutation
caption: GAG becomes TAG, a stop codon, so translation ends early and a shortened protein is made.
alt: The start of the beta-globin coding strand and the same sequence with the eighth codon changed from GAG to TAG; the protein stops after seven amino acids.
description: TAG, read as UAG in mRNA, is a stop codon.
The chain is released after seven amino acids: a shortened protein.
